location_exception_reason: Bio Toilets are institutional/infrastructure products evaluated on technology (DRDO certification, biodigester capacity, material), deployment context (Railways, defence, municipal), and specifications—not geographic origin. Location in title (e.g., 'Delhi Bio Toilet') adds no buyer decision value; the product function is identical regardless of manufacturing or installation location.
biz_exception_reason: IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, etc.) already exposes business relationship independently. Titles like 'Bio Toilet Manufacturer' or 'Bio Toilet Supplier' are redundant—removing the business-type word leaves the product complete and unambiguous. The product is a bio toilet regardless of seller classification.
